summary: Current HEAD 9be369d82332a4764b3462053f584522e6d8d706 is not PR-ready for release: the VibePro package still reports needs_verification/ready_for_pr_create=false, current-head review evidence is stale, and the branch scope versus origin/main is far too large for a story-scoped exact-run Lightsail rollout.
inspection_summary: Verified exact HEAD and branch status, then inspected the release-risk review request, .vibepro/pr/story-eve-meeting-candidates-pull-reconciler/pr-prepare.json, verification-evidence.json, senior-gap-judgment.json, decision-index.json, story and architecture docs, responsibility-authority JSON, the last two HEAD commits, and the full branch diff against origin/main; the branch is ahead 2 on codex/meeting-pack-eve-candidates-vibepro and spans 1961 files / 407792 insertions / 33320 deletions relative to origin/main.
judgment_delta: The narrow code delta at HEAD mainly updates workflows UI text and E2E coverage, but the release decision remains blocked by package-level readiness: exact-run Lightsail replay/backfill safety is only described at the story/architecture level (producer first, consumer deploy on Lightsail, replay only msrc_4f7c995f, no bulk backfill, rollback consumer first) while the current HEAD still lacks accepted production-path/runbook evidence and fresh serial gate reviews.

findings.title: Branch scope is not reviewer-safe for a story-scoped release gate
findings.evidence: git diff --stat $(git merge-base HEAD origin/main)..HEAD shows 1961 files changed, 407792 insertions, and 33320 deletions; this dwarfs the story-specific HEAD changes and prevents reliable release-risk isolation.
findings.impact: PR readiness cannot be established for an exact-run rollout when the review surface is this broad; hidden release interactions and rollback uncertainty remain too high.

findings.title: Current VibePro readiness artifact explicitly blocks PR creation
findings.evidence: .vibepro/pr/story-eve-meeting-candidates-pull-reconciler/pr-prepare.json reports overall_status=needs_verification, ready_for_pr_create=false, and critical_unresolved_gates including production_path_matrix, workflow_flow_replay, release_confidence, failure_mode_coverage, responsibility_authority, evidence_coverage, artifact_consistency, and senior_gap_judgment=block.
findings.impact: This HEAD has not cleared the required release gate chain, so approving the PR would contradict the package's own source-of-truth readiness state.

findings.title: Strict-head review evidence is stale for this exact HEAD
findings.evidence: pr-prepare.json preflight notes show recorded strict-head reviews on older SHAs such as 9a348b309d32, 04b31ed29ef0, and 25782dc2a087, while the requested review target is 9be369d82332a4764b3462053f584522e6d8d706.
findings.impact: Release-risk signoff at this exact HEAD is not yet established; serial gate execution requires fresh current-head evidence before PR approval.

findings.title: Exact-run Lightsail/backfill path is bounded in design but not closed with current-head operator evidence
findings.evidence: The story and architecture docs define a safe path: deploy Eve producer first, then Brainbase consumer on Lightsail, redispatch only run msrc_4f7c995f, do not bulk backfill the remaining 17 historical meetings, and rollback by reverting/disabling the consumer first. However, the PR package still marks production_path_matrix/workflow_flow_replay/release_confidence as unresolved and does not present completed current-head runbook evidence for that exact sequence.
findings.impact: The intended rollout is conceptually low-blast-radius, but it is not yet proven operationally enough to approve an exact-run production replay on Lightsail.

findings.title: Responsibility-authority evidence is still not cleanly closed for this story
findings.evidence: The inspected responsibility-authority artifact is docs/responsibility-authority/eve-meeting-note-pull-reconciler.json, and pr-prepare.json still flags gate:responsibility_authority as needs_evidence for story-eve-meeting-candidates-pull-reconciler.
findings.impact: Operational ownership and release accountability are not packaged cleanly enough to support production signoff, especially for replay/rollback execution.
